metadata.title: Survey Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for conducting surveys with clear authority, stated purpose, eligibility control, and response integrity.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Survey platforms, response collection engines, and survey orchestration services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational pattern defining baseline trust and integrity requirements for all survey activities, independent of consent, identity exposure, or data protection variations.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Survey core trust properties align with NIST SP 800-53 planning, identity, access control, and audit families.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Survey systems frequently interact with external populations and must maintain clear authority and responsibility boundaries.

metadata.remarks: Survey Core defines the non-negotiable trust properties required for any institutional survey. These invariants ensure surveys are authoritative, purpose-defined, scoped to an eligible audience, and protected against response manipulation. This pattern deliberately excludes consent mechanics, identity anonymization, and post-collection data governance, which are defined by complementary Secure Survey patterns.

components.title: Survey Authority and Authenticity
components.description: Ensures surveys are issued by an authorized institutional entity and are distinguishable from unofficial or deceptive instruments.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading through deceptive or unofficial survey instruments presented as legitimate.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding and authoritative issuance verify survey authenticity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Survey issuers are authenticated and authorized.
Policies define who may create and administer surveys.

components.title: Explicit Purpose Definition
components.description: Requires each survey to declare its purpose and intended use prior to data collection.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection of information without a clearly defined or legitimate purpose.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Purpose declaration and binding prevent scope creep and misuse.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Survey activities are constrained by defined and approved purposes.

components.title: Eligibility and Audience Scope Control
components.description: Ensures survey participation is limited to the explicitly intended audience.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid access mechanisms to participate in a survey outside the intended population.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access and eligibility enforcement restrict participation to approved respondents.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Survey participation is limited to eligible respondents.

components.title: Response Integrity and Protection
components.description: Protects survey submissions from manipulation, duplication, or unauthorized alteration.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or falsification of survey responses.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Integrity protection and validation mechanisms preserve response correctness.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity checks protect against unauthorized modification.

components.title: Survey Activity Observability
components.description: Provides auditability of survey creation, distribution, and response handling activities.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of evidence related to unauthorized or abusive survey activity.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and review support accountability and investigation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Survey events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports detection and investigation of misuse.
